card.name: Are before encouraged or invited
card.fires_on: The verb 'are' (or 're, is) or an adverb like strongly/highly after a group of people as subject, right before 'encouraged', 'invited' or 'welcome'.

modes.label: Are after a group subject
modes.description: The linking verb after a group such as all, healthcare providers or professionals, leading into an invitation.
modes.example: All<< are>> invited to the event, which is sponsored

modes.label: Adverb before encouraged
modes.description: An intensifier such as strongly or highly between 'are' and 'encouraged'.
modes.example: Healthcare providers are<< strongly>> encouraged to do all of the following:

modes.label: Welcome reply
modes.description: A contracted verb in a polite 'you're welcome' reply.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward invitation words such as encouraged, invited, advised and urged.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a sentence is about to say that people are encouraged or invited to do something.
